edges.reason: The relayer msg.sender is emitted in MetaTransactionExecuted and used as payable address
ContextMixin.msgSender branches on msg.sender == address(this)
When msg.sender is the contract itself the assembly path extracts the sender from msg.data

onlyFactory authorizes factoryMint using _msgSender()
onlyOwner approve() writes the operator directly into the proxy address used for transfers
Caller supplied operator becomes the proxy/approved address without validation

The operator written as proxy address is what the approval check later trusts

factoryMint drives the mint loop
The loop repeatedly invokes mintTo for the recipient
mintTo delegates to ERC721._safeMint
_safeMint invokes the receiver check on the recipient contract

mintTo reads currentTokenId.current() and increments the counter relative to TOTAL_SUPPLY

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter is only meaningful as the signer/from of the meta transaction entrypoint
Payload parameter flows directly into the arbitrary self-call
Nonce parameter is consumed by the nonce comparison and increment
Recovery id parameter exists only to feed signature verification
Option id parameter governs the mint loop performed by factoryMint
Recipient parameter is forwarded to mint, semantically part of factoryMint
Supply ceiling parameter is only used by the setter
Ownership candidate parameter belongs to the ownership transfer function
Operator parameter is written as the proxy address by approve
Domain name parameter is only hashed during EIP712 initialization
Mint recipient parameter is owned by mintTo semantics
Proxy toggle parameter only affects the proxy activation flag
Temporary struct is a pure staging local of the meta transaction entrypoint
Counter snapshot local is internal bookkeeping of mintTo
Minted id local is internal bookkeeping of mintTo
Call success flag is an artifact of the low level call only
Returned bytes are an artifact of the low level call only
Resolved sender local is the sole output of the sender resolution helper
Loop counter exists only to drive the repeated mint loop
